section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion section describes a study examining interpersonal and intrapersonal links to body appreciation and its connection to intuitive eating among college women. The study found that body appreciation played a central mediational role in linking caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety, and perfectionism to intuitive eating, but did not predict depressive symptoms, suggesting body appreciation is distinct from negative body image. The authors recommend exploring similar models with diverse samples.
